text.description_html:
Emtek Rope Lever with Rectangular Rose, EMT-8xx1R

From Emtek's Classic Brass Collection. Rectangular rosette combined with elegantly appointed Rope lever.

Features:

  • Adjustable for 1-3/8" - 1-3/4" Thick Doors
  • Standard 2-3/8" Backset - Optional 2-3/4" Backset
  • Strike: Standard Full Lip with Square Corner
  • Latch: Standard Square Corner Faceplate
  • Fits all pre-drilled Doors
  • Available in 6 Finishes
  • Handed Levers
  • Sold as Complete Set
  • Solid Brass Construction
  • Easy to Install

Available Functions:

  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking.
  • Dummy Pair: Rigid - For use as a pull or to match trim.
